# M77 independent integrated review

2026-09-16. **PASS for the bounded local application candidate identified below.** F01–F04 are resolved by independently executed challenges. This review does not accept hosted migration/recovery, final browser demonstration, publication, an inventory, released accounting methods or external assurance.

## Independence and execution context

Reviewer `/root/m76_cto` authored historical M76 and has no M77 implementation ownership. Root authored UI/integration; `/root/m77_backend` authored the backend. The requested registered QA-critical Astra/high dispatch was unavailable after the recorded thread-limit failures. Root explicitly assigned this review to the existing specialist context; actual observed model/effort is unknown. No author was the sole application release reviewer. This is software QA, not professional accounting or security accreditation.

Only new evaluation files and isolated fictional `m77_author_qa_*` databases were authored. No hosted requests, ENV loading, global-role changes, old-database edits or Git operations occurred. Local native requests use a fictional Auth adapter with actual HTTP routes, restricted runtime PostgreSQL access and the pinned Python subprocess. Client forgery cases use explicitly stubbed transport; they do not demonstrate a compromised native backend.

## Findings and independent resolution

| Finding | Original observed failure | Final challenge |
| --- | --- | --- |
| F01: retained physical discovery could disappear | Unsupported mobile append, omission and distinct acceptance all returned 201; current reconciliation became positive. | HTTP omission, null declaration and renamed identifier return 422. Direct runtime SQL independently raises the discovered-device guard. Correcting the same identifier to unknown facts succeeds and remains blocked. |
| F02: self-consistent report forgery lacked retained authority | Changed captured core plus recomputed hashes passed a download without an exact-version GET. | Historical HTML/JSON downloads obtain authorized report metadata and exact captured versions. Coordinated forged core with matching forged metadata is refused. Captured null reviews remain exact after later reviews. |
| F03: captured contributor closure could omit a new source preparer | Client register accepted a population missing its newly captured source contributor. | Exact union is checked against predecessor, corporate and resolved historical source contributors. Contributor omission and nonexistent dependency version pins are refused. Actual source/population contributor reviews independently return 403. |
| F04: outer captured review could differ from the saved decision | Same version core plus a changed captured review note and recomputed hashes passed the register decoder. | Captured nonnull review matches the exact saved decision. Forged review text and forged prior-review absence are refused through register and authorized downloads. Legitimate early captured null reviews remain readable. |

[First review](m77-first-review.md), [first receipt](m77-first-probe-result.json), [closure receipt](m77-closure-probe-result.json) and [captured-review receipt](m77-captured-review-probe-result.json) retain the original failures. The historical dependency-substitution probe is recorded as a client mutation observation; legitimate historical dependencies are supported, so substitution alone is not labeled a separate positive-coverage exploit.

## Independently executed evidence

- **Two final native tests, 404 assertions:** [integrated receipt](m77-integrated-native-result.json), 112 assertions on `m77_author_qa_final_1789597746599`; [binding/catalog receipt](m77-binding-native-result.json), 292 assertions on `m77_author_qa_binding_1789597746856`. Both check candidate bytes again before recording pass.
- **Eight independent calculator tests:** `python evaluations/research-qa/m77-independent-calculation.py` passed. Covers all admitted factors, exact source pins, maximum quantity, both half-even ties, 100-event bound, explicit zero, chronology, duplicate identities, declaration types and unsupported methods.
- **Thirty shared staging/browser-contract tests, 196 assertions:** independently ran `apps/site-api/src/staging/server.test.ts` and `apps/site-web/src/lib/workspace-api.test.ts`. These include actual staging dispatch checks through mocks and legacy client boundaries; they are not thirty M77-specific native tests.
- **Additional shared operator/hosted guards:** ten tests passed, nine unflagged native tests skipped, 92 assertions. The historical M76 operator remains frozen and correctly refuses an expanded manifest. This does not review or accept new M77 operators.
- **Default-run refusal:** both new native suites skip without `NEUVETRA_M77_QA_NATIVE=1`, performing no database work. CI can select `m63_integration` with `NEUVETRA_M77_CI_BASELINE=1`; that branch was prepared but not independently executed here.

Native evidence includes tenant/member/outsider/signed-out/origin denial; direct database write denial; eight forced-RLS tables; all new helper execute privileges and fixed search paths; retained event and contractor-reference refusal after the effective source removes its event; hand-derived maximum decimal and two known losses counted once; invalid units, precision, quantity types, gas and declarations; separately reviewed corrections; corporate contributor exclusion; missing corporate screening blocking numerical rebinding; source-ID correction preserving physical identity and numerical facts; orphan blockers until every discovered/source/workpaper relationship is resolved; and all retained captured report objects remaining exact.

The schema-19 clone comparison preserves **104 prior table data digests/counts**, plus the separately validated prior 19 migration receipts and additive receipt 20. The helper's private receipt is `.superpowers/m77_author_qa_binding_1789597746856-preservation.json`. Independent catalog comparison also preserves **159 existing function definitions, ACLs and security-definer flags**. The original schema-19 template remains unchanged.

A coordinated native report mutation removed a review that existed before capture and recomputed report/audit hashes. The reader returned 503. Original rows and immutable triggers were restored, and a subsequent native read passed. This distinguishes a legitimate early captured null review from forged historical absence.

## Reviewed application pins

Full file hashes are retained in the final integrated receipt. Material boundary pins:

Final 28-file application snapshot: `operations/agent-improvement/snapshots/M77-APPLICATION-CANDIDATE3.json`, SHA-256 `4de1ed6ce06beac338c0d20e0342305b3084db4389b61a00e64943da7a46d06c`. All 28 current files match the snapshot, and every overlapping native-tested file matches its final pin. Shared HTTP mounting, schema-20 readiness, workspace adapters/exports, migration manifest, Docker inclusion/deny filter, image-smoke source and CI wiring were reviewed. Docker execution and final remote CI results remain separate gates. Candidate 2 differed from candidate 1 only by LF normalization and the existing stationary-layout class; candidate 3 additionally closes F04.

SQL and TypeScript renderers were synchronized before final tests. Final files use LF; the earlier raw CRLF SQL hash `edee30fd...` and final LF hash `11d0b466...` represent identical canonical SQL. Actual native migration receipts always used the latter. Plain presentation labels, collapsed exact statements and collapsed snapshot provenance were inspected; final native report creation, reconstruction and downloads prove exact renderer parity. Physical layout/print behavior is not inferred from that byte verification.

Captured-review absence contradicts an applicable saved review strictly earlier than report creation. Equal milliseconds remain ambiguous and are admitted for independently verified native report authority, where audit sequence resolves chronology. Population applicability additionally requires its saved review dependency hash to match the report's captured reconciliation. These rules were inspected; the native audit forgery challenge independently demonstrates historical absence enforcement.

## Retained failed attempts

The initial reproduction and closure failures remain unchanged. A predecessor integrated run passed 105 assertions before the presentation repair; its byte-exact receipt is [retained separately](m77-integrated-native-pre-renderer-result.json). The intermediate 109-assertion run and schema-19 binding run are also retained in [pre-F04 evidence](m77-integrated-native-pre-captured-review-result.json) and [pre-normalization evidence](m77-binding-native-pre-normalization-result.json). F04 was found after those runs, repaired, and challenged on fresh final databases. Earlier final-suite attempts stopped at an incorrect QA expectation of 403 for an absent company (safe actual response 404), at correctly refused corporate source-history deletion, and during concurrent unsynchronized renderer authoring (`report semantic integrity`). Their new databases were preserved. The tests corrected the synthetic scenarios, and final passes used fresh databases. No failure was reset into a pass.

## Remaining acceptance boundaries

Root owns final physical browser/actor-transition verification, image packaging, CI/remote publication, independently reviewed operators, schema-19 backup/restore, populated schema-20 recovery, hosted exercise/restart and board demonstration. API abort-before-dispatch and late-response refusal were executed; actual React actor/company remount behavior was inspected, with physical transitions still a separate root gate. The root's earlier browser record explicitly predates the repairs.

Capacity checks and strict storage lineage were inspected; this review does not claim an independently populated 80-report/40-version maximum. The method cannot authenticate declared inspections, proper charge or contractor evidence. Unsupported mobile assets and missing facts block the bounded declaration. Scope 1 process/other source coverage, inventory aggregation, Scope 2/3, requirements applicability, released methods and qualified human assurance remain incomplete.

# M77 independent release-controls review

Prepared 2026-09-16 by `/root/m76_cto`, M77-RELEASE-CONTROLS. **PASS for publication of the exact new operator and hosted-journey software.** There are no open findings in this reviewed boundary. Actual hosted baseline, fresh backup/recovery review, upgrade, exercise/restart/revisit and board demonstration remain separate root-owned gates; this review does not mark M77 complete.

## Exact publication boundary

Seventeen files match `operations/agent-improvement/snapshots/M77-RELEASE-CONTROLS-CANDIDATE2.json`, SHA-256 `45028e1595e5845092c8c4a1f804031ae35a79561c2f07595bd1eabcabd7c45a`. Candidate1 remains preserved; candidate2 changes only the completed hosted-evidence documentation pin. A copy of the exact file pins is retained at `evaluations/research-qa/m77-release-controls-pins.json`. Canonical SQL20 remains `11d0b4667b28849c4d3e8c449344c23d5db2c29ef0ce14229d46a39291d932bc`; application semantics were not changed by this release-control review.

Final journey runner SHA-256 `3d9c84c6275d38f7b1e86d3fc3109a3d6872f662b92c42d547da27e41dac5796`; recipe `d498506db53d114e5c89bf3124de1189482092981495ce48a371c186f25ddf31`; tests `7c85ca9a2774a0bd23c5bae75a35cb1329521a350d1c200e33ccc090719ed45d`. The final hosted-plan documentation includes the completed6-test/2780-assertion author rehearsal and matches its snapshot pin.

## Recovery and execution evidence

The independently executed encrypted recovery and actual catalog/sequence/readiness controls are documented in `m77-operator-review.md`: new QA targets only; source19 and global roles unchanged; exact105-table19 restoration; additive113-table20; populated9-version/8-report encrypted forward recovery; all old numerical/proof/download replay; no replay mutation. Private forward receipt: `.tmp/m77-qa-release-1789598417086/restore20.json`, SHA-256 `fe687966181b3e83873a0f9d95bfc745d553005d1739fcb18d2aa58bc7617933`. Original19 receipt and source/restored content hashes are bound in that review. Provider recovery exclusions are exactly the prior policy, not a broader recovery claim.

Independent pure guards pass **18 tests / 197 assertions**, with the native journey intentionally skipped without its explicit local flag. This includes the new self-contained5-test/47-assertion QA suite: ordered intents/outcomes, attempt ownership, terminal verification, original M76 outcome compatibility, captured response equality, incomplete/failed session closure,503 failure, partial durability and zero-network retry refusal. Importing the tools reads no ENV/private fixture and performs no IO. CI's narrowly added guard step runs these pure tests; encrypted Windows native recovery remains a separate rehearsal. The exact M77 seal-script `-text` publication rule is included in the snapshot.

The completed author native journey was independently verified from its actual journal/receipt, rather than inferred from a success label:85 hash-valid events, exact **0/36/0 application POSTs**,30 successful additive writes and6 expected refusals; all three attempts passed with sessions closed; existing two facility objects and every old source object remain exact; earlier nonempty gas/generator/equipment histories and download/proof observations remain present; cumulative contributor exclusion and five captured absent reviews are retained. Final author receipt SHA-256 `cac4040d41e93d2b6ad6e48165f530d3aff189e2171cee96bb77c36e72c72747`; journal SHA-256 `de753e9fcefcfd4dde701abe8da3be11a45fb57178664d92582c6131a878beef`. Independent verification is retained in `m77-release-journey-result.json` and its read-only validator. This is local actual application-route/database execution with explicit synthetic Auth/legacy adapters and a reopened runtime connection; it is not real provider execution or an OS/host restart. I did not claim a second independently executed native hosted journey.

## Findings and closure

**F05 — hash-valid but semantically inconsistent journals were admitted.** Independent preserved reproduction admitted an orphan failed finish and an outcome before its durable intent. The author repaired both journal validators with ordered single-attempt ownership, exact clean closure/sent counts, matching terminal verification and ordered unique outcomes; legacy also binds exact verified response bytes. An independent compatibility check then found the first repair refused the actual immutable M76 continuation because its frozen outcomes lack duplicated route/role/expected fields. The bounded correction handles the original M76 outcome schema without editing it. Final actual predecessor acceptance and independent negative regressions pass. First reproduction and first-repair refusal evidence remain preserved.

**Private wrapper predecessor pinning.** The initial wrapper derived expected pins from the same current file, rather than compare independently accepted constants. Root corrected this before execution. Reviewed final wrapper `.superpowers/m77-private-upgrade.ps1` SHA-256 `a49bb9d81be0584dafacb5e9ea15f392141ae8fdfd5e6e9f60dfae302fbd2a6f` compares exact accepted continuation SHA-256 `836aa21776e0ea6dc847463ffb15f44a89175b74b9a896835eef8efe103fdf82` and terminal head `60fe0f9dd5d9db08c468de3f2afa227879d031b4318591b8e81bdf5cae924da7`. Those match the actual ordered chain: final recovery revisit0POST followed by passed/session-closed revisit0POST. Exact three-script allowlist, selected DATABASE_URL parsing without evaluation, encrypted synthetic Auth configuration, stdin-only secrets, suppressed provider errors and child argument handling were inspected read-only. No secret/config/ENV was opened or live execution performed by QA.

## Conditions and limitations

Root may publish these exact files, then perform the separately authorized read-only baseline and encrypted19 host backup after verifying the published head and checks. Hosted exercise and upgrade still require the fresh independent recovery/gate evidence; maintenance/head/check observations must remain fresh. No failed/uncertain intent or existing journal may be reset, overwritten or automatically replayed. Every created provider session must close; any uncertain sign-in/logout/durable append prevents acceptance. Fixed routes and explicit transport prohibit global fetch replacement in the hosted journey. Corporate corrections preserve historical reports but can make prior-family current bindings stale; no complete Scope1 sum is claimed.

Requested QA-critical Astra/high fresh dispatch was unavailable under the recorded thread limit. Root explicitly authorized reused historical-M76 context; inherited requested settings are not observed compute. Actual model/effort is unknown. I authored neither M77 operators nor journey. No host, Git, ENV, author-file edits or global-role changes were performed. Candidate factors and synthetic evidence remain unreleased/unverified; this review establishes no legal compliance, complete inventory or external assurance.
